title: PolyQuest quest-template resource
description: A reusable quest prototype. Store under data/<namespace>/quest_templates/**/*.json.

parameters.description: Unique parameter names accepted by this template.

prototype.description: A quest body, another template invocation, or a mixture containing ${name} markers. The fields below are editor hints, not pre-expansion validation; the expanded quest is validated by PolyQuest.

template.description: Invoke another quest template before applying the other top-level fields as overrides.

arguments.description: Named arguments for the nested template. Whole-value ${name} markers can supply objects, arrays, numbers, or strings.

availability.description: Usually daily or unique; a parameter marker is also allowed.

difficulty.description: Required after expansion for daily quests; omit for unique quests. May be a parameter marker.

title.description: Player-facing quest title. Text may contain ${name} markers.

description.description: Player-facing text lines, or a whole-value marker that expands to an array.

items.description: A text line; inline ${name} markers must expand to primitive values.

icon.description: Quest icon item identifier, possibly supplied by a parameter.

conditionHint.description: Editor suggestions for PolyQuest conditions. Dynamic markers and future condition fields are allowed here; the expanded quest receives full validation.

type.description: Condition type, or a whole-value parameter marker.

conditions.description: Trigger-specific Minecraft predicate object; deliberately unrestricted.

display_name.description: Optional player-facing objective label for advancement_criterion, consume_items or loot_item; supports template interpolation.
examples: Kill a zombie while holding a sword

item.description: Minecraft item predicate, or ${item} for a whole-value substitution.

entity.description: Minecraft entity predicate or a whole-value parameter marker.

count.description: Required number of matching events or items.

children.description: Nested conditions, or a whole-value parameter marker.

required.description: Number of branches required by n_of_m.

rewardPlanHint.description: Reward-profile reference or inline rewards. Whole-value parameter markers are allowed.

rewards.description: Inline rewards, or a whole-value parameter marker.

rewardHint.description: Editor suggestions for inline rewards; parameter substitutions are validated after expansion.

amount.description: Positive integer encoded as a string for a money reward.

stack.description: Minecraft item stack template or whole-value parameter marker.

title.description: Player-facing title for a command reward.

commands.description: Server commands to run, or a whole-value parameter marker.
